identity_authority.municipios: U.S. Census Bureau GEOID county-equivalent identifiers
identity_authority.barrios: U.S. Census Bureau GEOID county-subdivision identifiers

competing_geometry_authority.legal_basis: Ley 68 del 7 de mayo de 1945 and cited Planning Board territorial-boundary resolutions

municipio_layer.name: Límite de Municipio
municipio_layer.metadata_update: 2015-10 topology review / rectification noted in service description

barrio_layer.name: Límite de Barrio
barrio_layer.metadata_update: 2015-10 topology review / rectification noted in service description

invariants: SIGE name fields are candidate-generation evidence only and cannot establish canonical identity alone
Census GEOID identity may exist independently of SIGE geometry equivalence
barrios must preserve Census parent municipio GEOID and may not be matched across municipio parents
all SIGE geometries must preserve source EPSG:32161 and any EPSG:4326 derivative must carry explicit transformation provenance
duplicate normalized candidate keys remain unresolved
geometry overlap or equality cannot establish semantic identity without the Census stable identifier anchor
no unmatched source feature may be silently discarded

candidate_key_strategy.municipios: normalized Census BASENAME/NAME ↔ normalized SIGE Nombre
candidate_key_strategy.barrios: Census parent municipio GEOID + normalized Census BASENAME ↔ uniquely resolved SIGE MUNICIPIO + normalized SIGE BARRIO

provisional_geometry_thresholds.semantics: Passing these thresholds yields GEOMETRY_CANDIDATE_PASS only; never canonical identity certification. Threshold failures remain REVIEW rather than automatic rejection.
